{
  "phoneNote": "The licence-plate call button gives the page a trade-specific identity, but the workshop photo is obscured and the address arrives after the call action.",
  "desktopNote": "Oversized headings and the enormous phone plate dominate the hero, while the towing and process sections leave large areas of unused space.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 2,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 2,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce desktop headline and phone-plate sizes; make the towing section compact and arrange the four process steps horizontally to eliminate empty right-hand areas.",
    "Show the location before the hero call action, and consolidate the repeated address, hours and directions into one contact section.",
    "Give the workshop photo a clearer area beside the desktop hero text and a recognisable crop on phone, rather than obscuring it beneath text and a uniform dark overlay."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone: the upper blue information panel and lower booking panel repeat the same address, opening hours and directions block."
  ]
}
